answer: Verifiable-delay-sequencing bond stops bulk fakes. Each identity locks 70 credits, finishing one sequential delay proof; its output seeds the next delay, blocking parallel farms. The chain's nadir, its slowest step, beats rented rigs. Each proof sends a ripple down the queue: the k-th pays 35+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,032,000 against a 40,000 pool. A mirror ledger logs each proof; replay burns reused or rented proofs. Honest agents pay 35 once.
